before.scope: Sum of Instrumentation.getObjectSize over identity-distinct objects reachable from the loaded history before editing, the pending edit snapshot after a root deletion, and the union of remaining live history and snapshot; skip the Board owner back-reference, static fields and enum constants. Also subtract objects reachable from the remaining live history from the snapshot. Other application/VM roots are not subtracted: this is a graph footprint, not exclusive retained heap or peak RAM. Headless rules harness replaces UI/engine callbacks; no latency is measured.
